response.sql: WITH eq AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq), ab AS (SELECT eq.equipref, eq.avg_hum, ov.overall_avg FROM eq CROSS JOIN ov WHERE eq.avg_hum > ov.overall_avg), gm AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_avg FROM ab) SELECT ab.equipref, ab.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, ab.avg_hum - ab.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg, ab.avg_hum - gm.group_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM ab CROSS JOIN gm WHERE ab.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND gm.group_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The 'average across all equipment' is the mean of each equipment's own average humidity, so every equipment unit counts equally. Only equipment that appears in scanenvironment is included, and equipment with no humidity readings is ignored.
'Above-average' is a strict comparison (>). The group mean is the mean of the per-equipment averages in that above-average group. Ranking is by difference from the group mean, descending.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-equipment average is the plain average of all humidity readings (each reading weighted equally), not the mean of per-equipment averages.
